ChartQuery.description:
What a chart reads from the report input, structured so code can check it names things that exist.

Planner-written. An empty list or string means no filter there: every arm, every measure, every stratum, no
aspect, no limit (``limit`` 0).

source.description: The part of the report input the chart reads.
source.title: Source

aspect.description: The aspect id it reads, for readings and anything per aspect; else empty.
aspect.title: Aspect

measures.description: Measure or judged-dimension keys, as the source spells them.
measures.title: Measures

arms.description: Arm ids to show, in order; empty for every arm.
arms.title: Arms

strata.description: Stratum or task ids to keep; empty for all.
strata.title: Strata

limit.description: The most rows to show (strata by cases, examples); 0 for no limit.
limit.title: Limit

ChartQuery.title: ChartQuery

Claim.description: One claim of the story, in page order, with the evidence that shows it and the caveats said beside it.

id.description: The claim's id, unique in the document; the editor's findings name it.
id.title: Id

weight.description: How much it carries; it sets the claim's type size and nothing else.
weight.title: Weight

evidence.description: The one or two blocks that show it.
evidence.title: Evidence

caveats.description: The ids of the caveats stated beside this claim; may be empty.
caveats.title: Caveats

durable.description: Whether the claim should outlive this campaign, as an insight later ones read.
durable.title: Durable

Claim.title: Claim

DecisionEntry.description: One entry of the decision block: the slot word that titles it, and what it says.

text.description: What the entry says, figures by key.
text.title: Text

DecisionEntry.title: DecisionEntry

DocCaveat.description: One caveat the call's confidence carries: open, with what would make it material, or checked immaterial.

id.description: The caveat's id: one code assigns on the snapshot (caveats_list lists them), or `analyst:<slug>` for one code does not assign.
id.title: Id

label.description: The caveat's name as the page prints it. Optional for a code caveat, which code labels by its kind; required for an `analyst:` caveat.
label.title: Label

material_if.description: For an open caveat: what would make it material, figures by key. Exactly one of this and `checked`.
material_if.title: Material If

checked.description: `immaterial` for a caveat code proves does not move the call; the page prints code's reason. Exactly one of this and `material_if`.
checked.title: Checked

DocCaveat.title: DocCaveat

DocConfidence.description: How sure the call is, in one of three forms, and the caveats it carries, each once.

caveats.description: The caveats the confidence carries, open or checked, each once.
caveats.title: Caveats

DocConfidence.title: DocConfidence

Evidence.description: One evidence block under a claim: a kind of block over a query of the snapshot, as ``block_render`` draws it.

block.description: The kind of block, as block_catalog lists it.
block.title: Block

query.description: What the block reads, every field filled, as block_render returns it: an empty list or string is no filter, `limit` 0 no limit.

reference.description: The reference line to draw, which code keys from the snapshot; null for none.
reference.title: Reference

emphasis.description: The one arm, stratum or task the block stresses, by id; empty for none.
emphasis.title: Emphasis

caption.description: The line under the block, figures by key.
caption.title: Caption

Evidence.title: Evidence

ExploreRow.description:
One thing a reader could change and what it would do, in prose.

``outcome`` here, :class:`NextStep`'s ``settles`` and :class:`DocCaveat`'s ``label`` are model prose not typed
:data:`ModelProse`: the prose scan reads by attribute name, and other models read a structured ``outcome``,
``settles`` and ``label`` by value.

outcome.description: What happens as it moves, figures by key.
outcome.title: Outcome

ExploreRow.title: ExploreRow

MethodItem.description: One term of the method appendix, and the caveats whose reach is the method.

text.description: What it means here, figures by key.
text.title: Text

caveats.description: The ids of the caveats stated in this item; may be empty.
caveats.title: Caveats

MethodItem.title: MethodItem

NextStep.description: One experiment or declaration to make next, and what it would settle.
NextStep.title: NextStep

Omitted.description: One thing the analyst saw and left out of the body, and why; the appendix still holds it.
Omitted.title: Omitted

description:
A campaign report as the analyst writes it, report-doc/1: the story, the call and how sure it is, the decision
block, the claims in page order with their evidence, and the appendix's parts. Its prose names every figure by key.

story.description: The story the report tells; no code reads it.
story.title: Story

lede.description: What the headline rests on, figures by key.
lede.title: Lede

flag.description: One line above the decision for what a reader must know first; null for none.
flag.title: Flag

recommends.description: The arms the report recommends, by id, each once; empty for no call. The options table marks them.
recommends.title: Recommends

decision.description: The decision block's entries, in page order; a slot may repeat.
decision.title: Decision

claims.description: The story's claims, in page order.
claims.title: Claims

explore.description: What a reader could change; may be empty.
explore.title: Explore

omitted.description: What was left out of the body, and why; may be empty.
omitted.title: Omitted

next.description: The next steps, after the claims; may be empty.
next.title: Next

title: ReportDoc
